data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 私密居室的娇羞依赖温存
data.description: 只有床头微弱暖光映照的私密卧室，松软凌乱的床褥间，阿露身着轻薄修身的黑色蕾丝吊带。酒红色的大波浪长发铺散在枕上，雪白香肩与锁骨在暗光下诱人起伏。她侧卧在被褥上，将羞红发烫的面颊埋在老师掌心，展现出无与伦比的极尽顺从与深层依恋。
data.action: reclining on bed, blushing heavily, resting cheek in hand, sheer camisole, devoted surrender
data.lighting: seductive warm golden bedside lamp with soft dim silhouettes
data.mood: utter sensual surrender, deep romantic intimacy, and blissful devotion
data.promptProse: Reclining on a soft bedroom mattress in sheer black lace camisole, Rikuhachima Aru turns her flushed face into the viewer palm, her golden eyes melting with devoted affection.
data.animaCaption: Aru blushing heavily on the bed in a delicate black camisole.
